ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) ventral surface with localized high-intensity (white) anomalies; macro-level ratio exhibits a heavy bias toward dark pixels with high-contrast white highlights on scars and margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black field across both lobes. Distinct high-intensity white circular rosettes located mid-span on both lobes. High-density white clusters mapped to the distal lobe tips corresponding to barnacle colonization.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharply defined vertex; acute internal angle approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extensively serrated trailing edge with irregular, high-frequency pixel-amplitude variations; multiple prominent jagged peaks and deep valleys across the entire span from notch to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, forming an overall wide upward-curving arc with extreme vertical elevation at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent white circular ring scars on the left lobe mid-section; multiple smaller white circular marks on the right lobe; dense white bulbous barnacle clusters on the extreme distal edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal white linear scratch on the upper-middle region of the right lobe; multiple smaller, faint horizontal and vertical linear marks distributed across the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on the distal tips causing physical deformation of the edge geometry; multiple circular scars and linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical alignment of two prominent circular ring scars on the mid-left lobe.
